besluite.fout: In the glossary definition of 'dood', 'meer' stands at the end, after the object ('nie een van die lewensprosesse meer kan doen nie'). That is grammatical but reads a little stiff next to the lesson's own 'nie meer ... nie' pattern.
besluite.rede: The word order could read better, but this is a glossary definition that may be shared across lessons and it is not a plain spelling or grammar error, so the writer has to change it for every lesson at once.
